literal_meaning: ভাঙা কপালে জোড়া লাগানো (broken forehead being joined or mended)
figurative_meaning_en: The end of bad times and the arrival of good times
similar_in_english: Every cloud has a silver lining
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার জীবনে অনেক দুঃখের পর ভাঙা কপাল জোড়া লাগল যখন সে লটারি জিতল।
ব্যবসায় ক্ষতির পর ভাঙা কপাল জোড়া লাগার আশায় সে নতুন চেষ্টা করল।
example_sentences_in_english: After many hardships in his life, his broken fate mended when he won the lottery.
Hoping for his broken fortune to mend after business losses, he started a new venture.
note: This idiom reflects Bengali cultural views on fate (কপাল) as something that can change, similar to concepts in folklore.
